summary: Source secret scan passed; permitted live probes passed. No application files or sandbox state changed.

findings.evidence: 2026-10-24T01:54:35Z live HEAD / and GET /api/health: no Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. HSTS present. vercel.json only defines asset cache headers. server/standalone/key-setup.js:80-82 frame-protects its JSON response, not the containing SPA document.
findings.action: Add global framing policy appropriate to intended embedding (CSP frame-ancestors; X-Frame-Options when compatible), nosniff, Referrer-Policy and least-privilege Permissions-Policy in both deployment and dev-preview serving paths; re-HEAD root after coordinator applies changes.

findings.evidence: package.json requires Node >=24.14.0 <25 or >=26 <27; review-shell node --version is v22.23.3. Live sandbox Node version was not queried.
findings.action: Use a declared supported Node version for install/build/server and document sandbox runtime parity, or adjust engines only after compatibility tests. Health 200 is not production-build proof.

findings.evidence: ONDEMAND_API_KEY name is absent from app-root .env; live /api/health reports configured=true, ok=true. Values and process credentials were not read.
findings.action: Coordinator must preserve the existing app-owned running-server credential internally before restart as planned. Do not copy platform credentials into source or the downloadable .env. Verify configured=true again after restart.

findings.evidence: Server-side key use and client override controls protect credential handling, not automatically caller identity. Only health/root were probed; paid-route authorization was not exercised.
findings.action: Before public exposure, confirm trusted signed caller authentication/authorization and durable rate limits for paid chat, workflow and voice endpoints. A caller-supplied user header and same-origin checks alone are not authentication.

findings.evidence: Several .env.example provider names are absent from .env; see example_names_missing_from_env. Absence alone is not a startup failure: providers/config contain defaults, empty-key guards and registration-pack fallbacks.
findings.action: Document intentionally disabled/degraded providers; provision only required app-owned provider keys through approved secret management, never this platform's credentials.

findings.evidence: build/vite.js:33-36 explicitly serializes GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY and CESIUM_ION_TOKEN into browser defines. The usual VITE_ prefix restriction is intentionally bypassed for those names.
findings.action: Treat these as browser-public credentials with referrer/domain and API restrictions; use separate server-only credentials for privileged operations. Keep ONDEMAND_API_KEY out of browser define/import graphs.

positive_controls: Source-only node scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs passed (exact stdout/stderr retained).
Legacy browser key override is off by default; only explicit ONDEMAND_ALLOW_CLIENT_KEY enables it (server/ondemand/client.js:59-86). Configured flag value was intentionally not read.
Foundation proxy documents server-only credential handling; normal credential-less handlers have not_configured responses instead of inventing credentials.

Selftest requires configured ONDEMAND_SELFTEST_TOKEN plus matching x-selftest-token and fails closed with 404; comparison uses fixed-length SHA-256 digests and timingSafeEqual (api/ondemand/selftest.js:47-52,122-132). No token value read or request sent.
Credential JSON/no-store responses and Vite .env/.env.*/key/certificate/.git deny rules exist in source.

App root is self-contained: package.json, lockfile, vercel.json, index.html, server code, API catchall and browser dist entry present; root Vite config reexports existing standalone config without restructuring.

deployment_paths.routing_caveat: No literal api/route.js exists; api/[...route].js exists and can catch the rewritten path. Vercel adapter reconstructs the original request. Do not classify as confirmed broken routing from file absence alone. Production routing/bundling was not exercised.
deployment_paths.packaging_caveat: api/*.js includeFiles names config/**, data/** and CCTV height assets. Confirm src/registry/capabilities.json remains traced into deployed functions because fallback registration IDs depend on it.

env_defaults_review.method: Only .env assignment names were collected, never values; source defaults read statically, never imported runtime config.
env_defaults_review.server_key: ONDEMAND_API_KEY has an empty/no-key fallback; not_configured guard exists.
env_defaults_review.aliases: ONDEMAND_BASE_URL/ONDEMAND_API_BASE and endpoint names reconcile canonical-first; GODS_EYE_FLOW_VERSION precedes ONDEMAND_SPATIAL_FLOW_VERSION. These names appear in .env, but their actual values and consistency were deliberately not examined.
env_defaults_review.registration_ids: ONDEMAND_SPATIAL_AGENT_ID and ONDEMAND_SPATIAL_TOOL_ID may fall back to src/registry/capabilities.json; missing names are not necessarily missing capabilities.
env_defaults_review.not_every_reference_is_required: Vite DEV and platform VERCEL are injected signals; provider tuning variables are largely optional. Do not fill every absent name blindly.

limitations: No process credential reads, environment value inspection, application edits, dependency installation, git operations, browser use, sandbox restart or deployment.
Exactly two HTTP requests: GET /api/health and HEAD /. No other endpoint or method probed; no paid upstream operation requested by this reviewer.
Source scan excludes dist unless --dist; existing dist was not scanned. Regex scanner excludes some files, binaries and files >=20 MB and is not proof that all secrets are absent.
No dependency vulnerability audit, clean install, production build, runtime auth attack test or Vercel function-bundle verification performed.
Root/health header observations prove only the responses tested. Live app and current working tree parity was not established.
rg was unavailable; read-only Python inspection was used instead. No repeated failing command or tool installation.
